traps: GAAP vs operating EPS move in opposite directions: GAAP diluted EPS $2.27 down 2% vs operating (non-GAAP) $2.93 up 5%; the gap is acquisition-related adjustments of $0.58 and retirement-related adjustments of $0.08.
Net income likewise: GAAP $2.2 billion down 1% vs operating (non-GAAP) $2.8 billion up 5%.
Pre-tax margin by basis: GAAP 14.4% down 0.9 points vs operating (non-GAAP) 19.2% up 0.3 points; gross margin fell on both bases (GAAP 57.7% down 1.0 point, operating 59.4% down 0.7 points).

Revenue guidance is full-year constant currency (a non-GAAP measure) growth of four-to-five percent; the release gives no prior range, no direction of the update, and no EPS or dollar guidance; the margin outlook is only qualitative (improved pre-tax income margin expansion).
Free cash flow guidance is an increase of about $1 billion year over year, reiterated, not a full-year level.

Cash flow by basis: GAAP net cash from operating activities $2.6 billion up $0.9 billion vs free cash flow (non-GAAP) $2.5 billion down $0.3 billion; the swing comes from the change in IBM Financing receivables.

Quarter vs six months: six-month revenue $33.1 billion up 5%, GAAP EPS $3.55, operating EPS $4.84, free cash flow $4.8 billion flat, and Infrastructure up 1.9% year to date vs down 7.4% in the quarter.

Segment vs total: Software up 5% while total revenue rose 1%; inside Software, Hybrid Cloud (Red Hat) up 11%, Data up 19%, Transaction Processing down 8%; inside Infrastructure, IBM Z down 42% vs Distributed Infrastructure up 37%.
Constant currency: Software 5.1% reported vs 4.6% cc, Consulting flat reported vs up 1% cc, Financing 12% vs 11%; no total-company constant currency growth is given for the quarter.

Balance sheet: cash, restricted cash and marketable securities of $8.2 billion are down $6.3 billion from year-end 2025 after $10.5 billion of acquisitions this year; total debt is $62.0 billion including $13.0 billion of IBM Financing debt.
Units: the summary table uses a B suffix in billions, the comparative tables are in millions except per share amounts; $17,162 million is $17.2 billion; basic EPS is $2.30 and diluted is $2.27.

Non-financial figures are not results: the Power and Storage order backlog of nearly $500 million is backlog, the more than $10 billion quantum investment is over five years, and Lightwell's 7,500 patches are an operating count.
